exposure_hint: The CVSS vector says this flaw can be exploited over a network. Choosing Low exposure asserts that no IT or internet path reaches this device (for example, it is air-gapped or fully segmented), verified by testing. If an attacker gets into the OT network, any device that can route to this one could exploit it. Confirm the isolation by testing, or choose Medium. This note does not change the priority.

NEXT: Plan it into the next patch cycle (roughly 30-90 days).
